_note: Hosted demo, real PayPal sandbox, 2026-11-01. The case fields are as reported (stage CHARGEBACK, status WAITING_FOR_SELLER_RESPONSE, reason MERCHANDISE_OR_SERVICE_NOT_RECEIVED, three evidence types REQUESTED_FROM_SELLER); ids and the amount are placeholders. provide-evidence with evidence_type PROOF_OF_FULFILLMENT and evidence_info.tracking_info (carrier_name JPN_JAPAN_POST) was refused with HTTP 4xx and issue EVIDENCE_TYPE_IS_NOT_ALLOWED; the same shipment details as evidence_type OTHER (carrier and tracking number in notes) were accepted and the case moved to UNDER_REVIEW. The error body below is rebuilt from the reported status class, issue and debug_id field in PayPal's standard error format (name, message, debug_id, details[].issue); it is not a byte-for-byte recording, and the exact status (400 or 422) was not recorded, so tests use both.

error.name: UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY
error.message: The requested action could not be performed, semantically incorrect, or failed business validation.

details.description: The evidence type is not allowed for this dispute.
